accessibility:
- Uses native `<input type="range">` element
- The `label` prop, or the label of a `Field` the slider sits in, names its input.
- In range mode the label starts each thumb's name, so `<Slider range label="Price range" />` announces "Price range Minimum value" and "Price range Maximum value". Each thumb points `aria-labelledby` at the label and at a hidden span holding its own text, because an `aria-label` would outrank the label. The label's `for` still lands on the low thumb, so clicking the label focuses it.
- `ariaLabel` wins over the label. In range mode each entry is that thumb's whole name, with no label in front, and an empty entry counts as unset.
- An `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` you pass straight to a range Slider names the whole Slider, so it takes the label's place at the start of both thumbs' names: `<Slider range aria-label="Budget" />` announces "Budget Minimum value" and "Budget Maximum value". An `ariaLabel` entry still wins for its own thumb. To keep a label out of the thumbs' names altogether, pass `aria-labelledby={undefined}`, and they stay "Minimum value" and "Maximum value".
- A `Field` label you wire by hand with `labelProps={{ htmlFor }}`, as in a horizontal form, gets no generated id, so give it one of your own there as well, as in `labelProps={{ htmlFor: 'price', id: 'price-label' }}`, and it starts both thumbs' names the same way. Without that `id` it reaches a range Slider only through its `for`, which the thumbs' default `aria-label` outranks, so they stay "Minimum value" and "Maximum value".
- Has `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, and `aria-valuemax` attributes
- Fully keyboard accessible with arrow keys
- Focus states clearly visible
summary: The `Slider` component provides a range slider input for selecting values within a range.

parts.summary: The `Slider` component provides a range slider input for selecting values within a range.

props.name: range
props.description: Enables range mode with two thumbs.

props.name: minDistance
props.description: Minimum distance between thumbs in range mode.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: ARIA label(s) for the slider thumb(s), which win over a label, the Slider's own or a surrounding `Field`'s. In range mode each entry is that thumb's whole name, and a thumb without one is named "Minimum value" or "Maximum value", after whatever names the Slider: a label, or in its place an `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` given to the Slider, as in "Budget Minimum value" and "Budget Maximum value". An `aria-labelledby` set to `undefined` keeps every label out of both names.

props.name: nameLow
props.description: Form field name for the low thumb. Use this in range mode so each thumb submits with its own name.

props.name: nameHigh
props.description: Form field name for the high thumb.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label. Automatically associated with the slider input via `htmlFor` — uses your `id` when provided, otherwise a generated one. In range mode the `htmlFor` targets the low (minimum) thumb, and the label also starts each thumb's name through `aria-labelledby`, as in "Price Minimum value" and "Price Maximum value", unless an `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` on the Slider takes its place there. Dropped inside an outer `Field`, whose own label associates instead when that `Field` generates a target id (not `grouped`/`hasAddons`, no explicit `labelProps.htmlFor`), naming a range Slider's thumbs the same way. A `Field` label you wire by hand to the low thumb with `labelProps.htmlFor` names the thumbs too when you also give it an `id` there, since the `Field` generates none for it.

props.name: labelProps
props.description: Props for the label element. An explicit `htmlFor` here overrides the automatic association (no id is generated then). In range mode an `id` here is the one the thumbs' `aria-labelledby` points at, in place of a generated one.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Controls tooltip visibility on the thumb.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Shows tick marks along the track.

props.name: marks
props.description: Custom labeled marks along the track. Each mark has `{ value: number; label?: ReactNode }`.

props.name: scale
props.description: Function to scale the displayed value.

props.name: labelSize
props.description: Size for the label (used in horizontal layouts).

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the Field wrapper.

extraProps.name: ref
extraProps.description: Ref forwarded to the input element.
